question: In which part of the cell is ribosomal RNA synthesized ?:
reasoning_chain: CHAIN: Nucleolus -> Site of ribosomal RNA synthesis -> 95% CHAIN: Nucleolus -> Inside the nucleus -> 90% CHAIN: Nucleolus -> Ribosomal RNA precursor molecules -> Synthesized -> 95%
enhanced_information: Ribosomal RNA is synthesized in the nucleolus, a substructure inside the cell nucleus. The nucleolus is the site where ribosomal RNA precursor molecules are synthesized, aligning with standard consensus knowledge.
analysis: Ribosomal RNA is synthesized in the nucleolus, a well-established fact in cell biology. The nucleolus is the site where ribosomal RNA precursor molecules are produced.
